name: Big Fish Small Fish - Century Square
description:
Big Fish Small Fish is your go-to seafood spot, known for our mouthwatering Fish & Chips and a wide range of other delicious fish dishes. We offer a one-of-a-kind dining adventure where you can customize your meal with your favorite fish fillets, batter styles, and tasty sauces.

Our focus is on delivering fresh, high-quality seafood that you can enjoy just the way you like it. Plus, we love adding our own creative twists to classic seafood favorites, making every visit a delightful culinary journey.

We pride ourselves on serving fresh, quality seafood with a variety of options from battered fish to grilled selections. Our casual and family-friendly setting makes us the perfect place for gatherings, quick lunches, or hearty dinners. 

Visit us today and enjoy a delightful meal that’s big on taste! (Mar 2026)
